# Wedding India Expo

> India's First International Destination Wedding Exhibition connecting wedding planners, venues, hotels, tourism boards, designers, decorators, caterers, photographers, technology providers, and destination wedding professionals worldwide.

## About
- Website: https://www.weddingindiaexpo.com
- Event: Wedding India Expo 2027
- Date: 5-7 March 2027
- Venue: Yashobhoomi (IICC), Dwarka, New Delhi, India
- Organizer: The Exhibition Network

## AI Summary

Wedding India Expo is India's first international destination wedding exhibition bringing together wedding planners, destination venues, luxury hotels, tourism boards, decorators, caterers, designers, photographers, technology providers, and wedding brands. The exhibition promotes India as a global destination wedding hub while connecting international buyers and suppliers through exhibitions, conferences, networking, and business matchmaking.
